sections.heading: Core Concepts: Volume of pyramids and cones

questions.q: For the model $f(x) = 6x + 9$ in volume of pyramids and cones, evaluate $f(2)$.
Find the positive solutions to the quadratic equation $x^2 - 5x + 4 = 0$.
A data set recorded for volume of pyramids and cones consists of the four values $\{16, 20, 24, 30\}$. What is the arithmetic mean?
questions.answer: The sum is $16 + 20 + 24 + 30 = 90$, and dividing by $4$ gives $22.5$.
